name: Dallah Hospitals
verdict: The hospital group of Dallah Healthcare Company (Tadawul: 4004), 47.4% held by Dallah Albaraka Holding. Nothing found.
note: Al-Fateh's partner is listed as 'مستشفيات دله الأحساء' (Dallah Hospitals Al-Ahsa) on the club's partners page; its logo sits below the player number on the back of the 2026/27 home shirt. Rating note: Dallah Healthcare acquired Al Ahsa Hospital (renamed Dallah Al Ahsa Hospital) and its 2025 annual report shows Dallah Al-Baraka Holding Company as major shareholder with 47.4%. Dallah Albaraka is a private Jeddah-based group founded by Saleh Abdullah Kamel; no state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
